What we do

Maintenance, repairs and projects — handled.

From scheduled upkeep to the jobs that crop up unexpectedly, OnePoint keeps your property running. Three ways we work, one relationship.

Planned maintenance

Scheduled visits that keep your property in top condition and head off costly problems before they start.

  • Scheduled property inspections
  • Grounds maintenance & exterior cleaning
  • Pressure washing & gutter clearing
  • Minor repairs & touch-up painting
  • Fence & gate inspections

Reactive maintenance

When something needs fixing, one call gets it sorted — quickly, properly and with minimal disruption.

  • Fence, gate & carpentry repairs
  • Painting & gutter repairs
  • External building maintenance
  • Jet washing & landscaping repairs
  • General property repairs

Small projects

Improvements and refurbishments delivered with the same care and standards as the day-to-day work.

  • Office redecorations
  • Warehouse painting
  • Landscaping & new fencing
  • Small refurbishments
  • External improvements & minor fit-outs

For larger or specialist work, we coordinate trusted subcontractors and manage the whole project on your behalf — so you still only deal with one point of contact.

How it works

One call. We handle the rest.

No chasing multiple trades, no juggling quotes. You get a single, dependable partner who knows your property.

01

One call

Tell us what your property needs. One number for maintenance, repairs and projects — no triaging between contractors.

02

We plan & manage

We schedule the work, brief our team and coordinate any specialist subcontractors — and keep you updated throughout.

03

One clear invoice

The job gets done to a high standard and you receive a single, transparent invoice. Simple to budget, easy to approve.

Built for commercial property.

We work with the people responsible for keeping buildings and grounds in good order — day in, day out.

We also look after residential homeowners, private landlords and letting agents who value the same dependable service.

Recent Work

A few jobs we're proud of.

A mix of residential and commercial projects, from a weekend garden tidy-up to a multi-week office fit-out. Tap a project to see more.

ResidentialSupply & fit · Edgbaston

Kitchen extension & garden room

A tired single-storey kitchen became a full-width glass extension with bi-fold doors onto the garden — plus a new lawn and beds to match.

The brief was simple: more light, more space, and a proper connection to the garden. We took down the old lean-to, built out with a steel frame and full-height glazing, then finished the interior with underfloor heating and a run of handleless cabinetry. Once the building work was done, we relaid the lawn and tidied the borders so the new room had a garden worth looking at.

Duration
7 weeks
Scope
Extension, glazing, garden
Team
4 tradespeople
ResidentialGardens & landscaping · Solihull

Lawn renewal & garden tidy-up

A patchy, uneven lawn and overgrown borders, turned into a clean, level garden ready for summer.

The existing lawn had been patched too many times and never took evenly. We stripped it back, levelled the ground and laid fresh turf, then cut back and replanted the borders along the fence line. A two-day job that made the whole garden feel new again — done in time for a family barbecue that weekend.

Duration
2 days
Scope
Turfing, borders, edging
Team
2 gardeners
CommercialSmall building & projects · Birmingham

Office fit-out for a city-centre HQ

A dated open-plan floor reworked into a modern meeting and collaboration space for a growing team.

Our client had outgrown their old layout and needed something that felt more like a destination floor than a corridor of desks. We reworked the space around a central meeting table, added acoustic ceiling treatment and exposed-services lighting, and rewired for the new AV setup — all completed over two weekends so the team never lost a working day.

Duration
3 weekends
Scope
Fit-out, lighting, AV
Team
6 tradespeople
CommercialSupply & fit · Nottingham

New-build shell & core, phase one

Structural and groundworks support for the first phase of a new residential-and-retail development.

Working alongside the main contractor, our team supported the phase one groundworks and structural fit — steel fixing, formwork and site coordination across a live build programme. It's the kind of larger-scale, safety-critical work that sits alongside our day-to-day maintenance jobs, delivered by the same vetted, insured team.

Duration
14 weeks
Scope
Groundworks, structural
Team
9 tradespeople
